Matchup matrix (84 characters, every matchup in the data)

The whole dataset: every character that appears in a counted game, most played first, and every pair that met, however few games they have. Cell is the row character's winrate against the column character, games in brackets, from 4,364 games with both characters reported. Scroll sideways; the row character stays pinned. Small samples read with care: a cell can rest on a single game. Random Character is not in here: it's a random pick from the roster, not a character. Only games with both characters reported count; a game with just one side reported, or neither, is left out entirely. The same pairs are in data/matchups.json.

Shading key, row character's winrate: 10% 30% 40% 50% 60% 70% 90%
Red favours the column character, green the row; darker is further from 50%. Almost-white cells are under 3 games, so barely shaded whatever the winrate. — mirror match, · no reported games. The number in brackets is games played. Click a cell to highlight its row and column so you can follow them across; click it again to clear.
